title: ArcticDB `universe` library -- one symbol frame row (v1)
description: Column/dtype/index contract for the ArcticDB `universe` library (nousergon_lib.arcticdb.UNIVERSE_LIB), read read-only via load_universe_ohlcv/open_universe_lib -> _load_arctic_frames. One row per (symbol, trading day): a tz-naive DatetimeIndex date value plus the OHLCV_COLUMNS ('Open','High','Low','Close','Volume'). _load_arctic_frames normalizes to a monotonic DatetimeIndex, tz-stripped, duplicate index values collapsed keep=last. Bitemporal columns (settled, as_of, source_tier, valid_date, knowledge_time) are ADDITIVE (config#2459) -- absent on rows written before that change, present is never required. `VWAP` and `atr_14_pct` are likewise ADDITIVE and nullable -- both are written by builders/daily_append.py (VWAP from `_load_daily_closes`'s polygon-sourced `vw` field, null on yfinance/FRED rows per the 2026-04-17 VWAP-centralization decision; atr_14_pct from features/feature_engineer.py::compute_features, NaN during the <14-row ATR warmup window) and are absent on rows written before this contract update. Consumer: crucible (v2 data.daily, first-class), crucible/crucible/data/sources.py::ArcticPriceSource.load_panel -> normalize_panel, which renames Open/High/Low/Close/Volume -> open_raw/high_raw/low_raw/close_raw/volume_raw (PANEL_COLUMNS) and raises MissingSourceError on any missing OHLCV column -- never zero-fills; crucible-executor's `price_cache.load_atr_14_pct` hard-fails when `atr_14_pct` is absent from the frame entirely (column-level, not row-level -- NaN values are handled downstream). v1 predictor/research until phase 4 (retiring). Plan §3 boundary table row 3.

index_date.description: The frame's DatetimeIndex value for this row, tz-naive, no intraday component after normalization.

VWAP.description: Raw price, bare name (grandfathered alongside Open/High/Low/Close/Volume -- not a features/registry.py CATALOG entry, so outside the units-suffix contract). Polygon volume-weighted VWAP; null on yfinance/FRED-sourced rows (no true VWAP available). Producer: builders/daily_append.py::_load_daily_closes.

atr_14_pct.description: ATR(14) / Close, decimal pct (`_pct` suffix). Producer: features/feature_engineer.py::compute_features, written into the universe row by builders/daily_append.py. Null during the ATR warmup window (<14 rows of history). Registered feature: features/registry.py::CATALOG.
